preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 2*10**5 for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of vertices N is between 1 and 2*10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(C) == N for N, C in [(int(input().split()[0]), input().strip()) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the color string C is equal to the number of vertices N.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'RGB' for c in C) for C in [input().strip() for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the color string C consists only of the characters 'R', 'G', and 'B'.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == N - 1 for N, edges in [(int(input().split()[0]), [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(int(input().split()[0]) - 1)]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of edges is exactly N - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and u != v for u, v in edges) for N, edges in [(int(input().split()[0]), [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(int(input().split()[0]) - 1)]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, each edge connects two distinct vertices within the range 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] in ['Yes', 'No'] for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: all((all(any(c == 'R' for c in path) and any(c == 'G' for c in path) for u, v in blue_pairs for path in [get_path(u, v)]) if blue_pairs else True) for blue_pairs, get_path in [(get_blue_pairs(N, C, edges), get_path) for N, C, edges in [(int(input().split()[0]), input().strip(), [tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(int(input().split()[0]) - 1)]) for _ in range(T)])])
postconditions.description: For each test case, if there are pairs of Blue vertices, there is at least one Red and one Green vertex on the simple path between each pair of Blue vertices.
